rules.description: Database connection string must be configured.
Database retry count must be configured.

rules.ruleName: Service Bus queue must not be empty
rules.description: Service Bus queue name must not be empty.
Database command timeout should be between 5 and 120 seconds.
rules.recommendation: Adjust Database:CommandTimeout to a value between 5 and 120.

rules.description: Database provider must be one of the supported providers.
rules.recommendation: Set Database:Provider to AzureSql or SqlServer.

rules.description: Service Bus namespace should follow the sb-<name> naming convention.
rules.recommendation: Rename the Service Bus namespace to match ^sb-[a-z0-9-]+$.

rules.description: Configuration must exist for the requested session year.
rules.recommendation: Publish configuration for the requested session year before running assessments.

rules.description: Database command timeout should be consistent across Assessor applications.
rules.recommendation: Align Database:CommandTimeout across applications for the same environment/tenant/session year.

rules.ruleName: Service Bus queue consistent across environments
rules.description: Service Bus queue naming should be consistent between Production and Staging.
rules.recommendation: Align ServiceBus:Queue naming across environments for the same application/tenant/session year.
